8.3.7.2 Bus topology
If EthTrcvPhysLayerType is set to TRCV_PHYS_LAYER_TYPE_10BASE_T1S, the fol-
lowing requirement of this subsection has to be applied:
[SWS_EthTrcv_00197]
Status: DRAFT
⌈If EthTrcvPhysLayerType is set to TRCV_PHYS_LAYER_TYPE_10BASE_T1S, the
function shall internally store the requested link state and return E_OK.⌋
Note: this state is needed in context of EthTrcv_GetLinkState().
caption: 8.3.7.2 Bus topology
